tbesh_html:
1) to hurl, cast
1a) (Pilpel) to throw away, carry away, hurl
1b) (Hiphil) to throw, cast, cast out
1c)(Hophal)
1c1) to be hurled, hurled down
1c2) to be cast, be thrown, be cast out, be thrown down

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out
strongs_1890.kjv_def: carry away, (utterly) cast (down, forth, out), send out.
